initial.campaign:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a premium Warline Capture mobile landscape RTS result-screen design board containing TWO complete 16:9 screens stacked vertically, victory above defeat, at matching scale. Target board 2400x2724 pixels, with only a 24px dark gutter between the two screens. Both screens must be complete uncropped layouts and large readable UI, not device photos, not perspective.
Reference image roles: reference 1 is the ACTUAL Campaign result screen, for existing game's bold squared Oxanium-like typography and low-poly desert world only; improve its layout radically. Reference 2 is the CURRENT polished Settings UI, for navy steel panel materials, thin steel borders, blue navigation and green positive action button quality. Reference 3 is EXISTING campaign comic art, use that character/low-poly visual language inside the mission thumbnail; do not invent characters. Preserve the Warline game identity.
A single clean consistent design system for future Campaign, Skirmish, Operations. Full navy teal/charcoal canvas over a very subdued desert-city backdrop. Slim steel borders 1-2px, separate panels with 16-24px gutters, 24px minimum inner padding. No decorative yellow strokes. No adjacent touching or overlapping panel borders. Bold readable white typography, cyan small section headings, green completion indicators, reserved amber warning. Subtle rich material gradients like reference 2; attractive and colorful but highly readable. Mobile-safe controls. No tiny text, no giant empty black voids.
IDENTICAL layout for both outcomes: slim top breadcrumb/header reading "CAMPAIGN / CHAPTER I", mission identity "M01 • FIRST CONTACT" and cyan location "OLD MARKET". At right a compact labeled duration chip. Next outcome ribbon with a small appropriate shield/check icon and "VICTORY" green at top screen, "DEFEAT" red at bottom screen. Plain one-line reason underneath. Three aligned body columns: left 30% mission comic thumbnail at 16:9 and a concise debrief block below; middle 42% three big objective rows; right 26% performance rows and rewards. Bottom action bar with well separated large buttons, all same heights. Footer primary action is broad green positive-action button; navigation secondary is blue with the same beige back arrow as other menus.
TOP screen exact content: duration "00:44"; reason "All required objectives complete."; objectives "Neutralize hostile patrol" with "3 / 3" and green check, "Keep command squad alive" with "COMPLETE" and green check, "Protect civilians" with "0 LOST" and green check. Three earned gold stars in a compact rating block, do not dominate header. PERFORMANCE: "Squad losses  0", "Enemies defeated  3 / 3", "Civilians lost  0". REWARDS: gold chevrons with "Commander XP  +260" and gold COINS with "Credits  +1,200". Left comic thumbnail shows existing commander at observation window, desert forces visible; caption "FIRST CONTACT". Debrief text "Hostile patrol neutralized. The Old Market corridor is secure." A small cyan next-step line "Continue to the debrief." Footer secondary "CHAPTERS", neutral "REPLAY", dominant green "CONTINUE" with beige double chevron, small "Progress saved" above footer.
BOTTOM exact content: duration "01:12"; reason "Command squad lost."; same mission thumbnail subtly darkened, not graphic violence or a new explosion. Three unearned neutral steel star outlines, compact. Objectives "Neutralize hostile patrol" with "1 / 3" amber, "Keep command squad alive" with "FAILED" red, "Protect civilians" with "0 LOST" green check. PERFORMANCE: "Squad losses  1", "Enemies defeated  1 / 3", "Civilians lost  0". Reward area says "No clear reward" neutrally, with no gold awarded currency. Debrief "The command squad was lost. Regroup and try again." Bottom blue "CHAPTERS" secondary and broad green "RETRY MISSION" with replay arrow primary. Do NOT show both Retry and Replay on defeat, no celebratory victory emblem on defeat. Avoid loadout controls, new rewards, new mechanics, settings clutter, rank banners, ornate wings, yellow outlines.
Keep copy concise and exact and margins generous. Two polished in-game full screens, not annotated wireframes.
initial.skirmish:
Use case: ui-mockup. Make a premium Warline Capture result design board, TWO complete landscape 16:9 game screens stacked vertically, victory above defeat, matching scale and complete uncropped borders. Target 2400x2724 including a narrow 24px dark separator. Reference 1 is the APPROVED-FOR-CONSISTENCY CAMPAIGN PROPOSAL you must precisely match in layout, materials, font size, section locations, padding and button treatment. It is a visual design reference, not in-game evidence. Reference 2 is the ACTUAL CURRENT mode result render: use it for actual mission facts only, improve its design. Reference 3 is an ACTUAL existing game map preview: use it in the mission thumbnail, retain its low-poly world. Do not invent a new physical map. Match reference 1's navy teal steel, bold squared Oxanium-like typography, cyan information headers, green success indicators, restrained red failure reason, gold earned stars and medals only. Thin 1-2px steel borders. Each card has at least 24px padding and visible 16px gutter around it; separate neighboring borders, no touching doubled strokes. No decorative yellow borders, no giant empty black areas, no tiny text. Small dark desert backdrop, much less prominent than readable UI.
Keep EXACT SAME GRID as reference1 in both outcomes: top mission identity plus duration, outcome ribbon, body left30% thumbnail and concise aftermath text, middle42% objective checklist, right26% performance plus a mode-specific lower panel. Bottom all buttons same height with large hit areas. Top success uses small green shield/check and VICTORY; bottom uses small red shield/X and DEFEAT. Never retain green celebratory emblem on defeat. Compact stars gold when earned, neutral steel empty when unearned. Failed objectives should still preserve any completed rows. Exactly ONE Restart action on defeat; never simultaneous Retry and Replay. Blue navigation, neutral secondary replay on victory, broad green retry on defeat. No new rewards or currencies, invented progress, loot boxes, device photos, outside annotations. White body text and generous RTL-ready padding, with no text close to border.
MODE: SKIRMISH.
TOP exact text: "SKIRMISH / DESERT BASE"; "S002 • COMMAND SIEGE"; metadata "BASE ASSAULT • RECRUIT"; duration "06:42"; VICTORY reason "Enemy HQ destroyed. Your main base held."; compact 3 gold stars. Thumbnail existing city/base preview with accurate desert low-poly buildings. Caption "COMMAND SIEGE". Summary "Battle won. Choose another mission or replay this battle." OBJECTIVES: "Destroy the enemy HQ" COMPLETE green; "Protect your main base" HELD green; "Keep squad losses low" "2 LOST" green. PERFORMANCE: "Units lost  2", "Units defeated  12", "Buildings lost / destroyed  0 / 1". Lower right panel heading "MEDAL" with a small bronze star medal icon and "Recruit medal earned" plus "S002 • First award". No Credits or XP reward panel for Skirmish. Footer neutral "MAIN MENU" small link/button at left, secondary neutral "REPLAY", dominant BLUE navigation "BATTLEFIELD" with map icon on right. A small save-confirmation line "Medal recorded" only in victory.
BOTTOM same metadata, duration "05:18", DEFEAT reason "Your main base was lost."; compact 0/3 neutral outlined stars. Same thumbnail modestly darkened. Summary "Enemy HQ still standing. Regroup and try again." OBJECTIVES "Destroy the enemy HQ" "NOT COMPLETE" amber; "Protect your main base" FAILED red; "Keep squad losses low" "8 LOST" red. PERFORMANCE "Units lost  8", "Units defeated  6", "Buildings lost / destroyed  1 / 0". Lower right "MEDAL" says "No new medal" neutral. Footer BLUE "BATTLEFIELD" back/navigation at left, neutral "ADJUST SETUP" in middle, dominant green "RETRY BATTLE" at right. No main-menu duplication at defeat and no Replay beside Retry. These are review mockups with illustrative values, not actual rewards or a new game mode.
